gap: The desktop fold is vertically unresolved: the whole form stack lives in rows 160-760 of a 1250px viewport, the aside card stops dead at row 590, and everything from row 760 down to the stranded 'Secured by Paymob' line at row 1190 is unassigned cream, so the bottom-right quadrant is a hole and the page reads unfinished rather than calm. Wave's folds never leave an orphaned void: pricing optically centers its stack in the viewport, home fills the opposite half with product imagery. Fix it by centering the two-column block on the vertical axis (justify-content:center on the main region with the footer as a real pinned bar), and let the right-hand card carry its weight to roughly the same baseline as the Continue button, so the fold resolves as one composed frame instead of content pushed to the top-left with dead space beneath.
